title: Delegation summary-count fixture tests should also assert that no inconsistency note is emitted
outcome: In src/tests/delegation_result_summary_counts.rs (added by w-a7c465026c6c), the two verbatim evaluator-fixture tests assert only findings.is_empty(). Add assert!(inconsistency_notes(&parsed).is_empty()) to both, as the zero/label/tally test already does, so a future heuristic change cannot reintroduce the false signal as a note on clean evaluator output without failing a test.
acceptance: Delegation summary-count fixture tests should also assert that no inconsistency note is emitted is done
